Hi Elena — thanks for reaching out and great to e-meet you.

Short answers up front (we can go deeper on a call):
- We support three primary partner motions: referral (finder's fee), reseller (order capture + commission), and co-sell (joint pursuit with registered credit). Typical referral fees range 8–20% depending on deal size and whether the partner brings the contract or just the introduction. Resale margins vary by volume commitments; we can provide tiered tables.
- Standard lead registration protection: 90 days for inbound marketing-introduced leads; 180 days for partner-introduced MQLs with validated discovery. We can extend on a per-deal basis with registration form + activity requirements.
- Demo/POC credits: we offer limited credits for strategic partners (usually 1–3 demo credits, redeemable against hosted API usage).
- Clawbacks: 3–6 month pro-rata clawbacks for cancellations/chargebacks for referral fees; reseller commissions follow a 12 month clawback window in some templates.

I attached our partner capabilities overview to give more context. If you want, I can loop in our commercial ops and partner programs lead for the detailed commission matrix.

Would you be available for a 30-minute call next week (Dec 7–9)?

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Head of Partner GTM | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the ping — drafted a concise framework below we can share with Starlight. I kept it prescriptive so sales has something to take to the partner quickly.

Proposed commercial framework (summary):
1) Motions & Commissioning
   - Referral: 12% standard on first 12 months of net subscription revenue for partner-sourced deals (paid within 45 days after customer payment clears).
   - Reseller: margin-based discounting; partner purchases at NET25 (i.e., 25% off list) for ARR < $250k; for ARR >= $250k scale to NET35 with a minimum 12-month commitment.
   - Co-sell: 8% credit toward partner pipeline incentive when Redwood-owned sales leads are handed to partner with validated discovery.

2) Registration & Validation
   - Registration window: partner must register via form; protection window 180 days for partner-sourced qualified opportunities with activity evidence (logged discovery call + account owner assignment).
   - Validation checklist: company domain, contract decision-maker, expected ARR band, and short discovery notes.

3) Demo/POC & Credits
   - Strategic demo credits: 2 credits for onboarding partners that meet minimum 3-customer pipeline target; credits redeem against hosted usage up to $25k equivalent.

4) Clawbacks & Chargebacks
   - Referral clawback: pro-rata over first 6 months if customer cancels or materially downgrades within the first 6 months.
   - Reseller commission adjustments: commissions subject to reconciliation at invoice settlement; standard 12-month repayment obligation on material refunds.

5) Exceptions & Escalations
   - For enterprise logos or multi-region regulated deals, escalate to Partner Ops for bespoke terms (can include extended registration, multi-year guarantees, or higher margins).

I've added a short registration form and a MAL (mutual action list) template we use — attached. If this looks good, Jasmine can send to Elena as the formal proposal (we should keep one PDF + the MAL doc for signature).

—Marissa
